finding: Borderline personality disorder (BPD) was associated with an increased risk of gestational diabetes, premature rupture of the membranes, chorioamnionitis, venous thromboembolism, caesarean delivery, and preterm birth.
mod_finding: BPD was associated with an increased risk of caesarean delivery (OR, 1.44; 95% CI, 1.26-1.64).
